item.title: LENGTHY HARRIS COUNTY PURSUIT IS NOW A MANHUNT
item.description: 106am-A PURSUIT THAT STRATED NEAR LOUETTA AND 249 HAS ENDED OFF ELLA BETWEEN AIRTEX AND KUYKENDAHL-THE MALE IN DARK CLOTHING CRASHED ONCE DURING THE CHASE BUT CONTINUED WITH TIRES FALLING OFF. HE IS NOW IN THE YARDS ON MAJESTIC EAGLE AND EAGLE FEATHER. MULTIPLE UNITS ARE SEARCHING THE VEHICLE WAS STOLEN
